# visualization.baseline_plot.plot_sampling_frame { #fmrimod.visualization.baseline_plot.plot_sampling_frame }

```python
plot_sampling_frame(
    sframe,
    style='timeline',
    show_ticks=False,
    tick_every=None,
    events=None,
    title=None,
    subtitle=None,
    caption=None,
    figsize=None,
    ax=None,
)
```

Plot the runs of a sampling frame (R ``plot.sampling_frame``).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                               | Description                                                                                                                                                                                  | Default      |
|------------|------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| sframe     | SamplingFrame                      |                                                                                                                                                                                              | _required_   |
| style      | (\'timeline\', \'grid\', \'lane\') | ``"timeline"``: one bar per run on a shared time axis; ``"grid"``: each run's scans as cells on a within-run scan axis; ``"lane"``: one row of adjacent run segments annotated above.        | `"timeline"` |
| show_ticks | bool                               | Timeline: white ticks every ``tick_every`` scans inside each bar.                                                                                                                            | `False`      |
| tick_every | int                                | Scans between ticks (timeline) or between shading changes (grid; default 5, or 10 for runs over 100 scans).                                                                                  | `None`       |
| events     | EventModel or DataFrame            | Onsets (``onset`` run-relative seconds and ``run``/``block``) drawn as ticks under each run, as a coverage check; runs without events and onsets outside their run are noted in the caption. | `None`       |
| title      | str                                | ``None`` uses the default; ``""`` removes it.                                                                                                                                                | `None`       |
| subtitle   | str                                | ``None`` uses the default; ``""`` removes it.                                                                                                                                                | `None`       |
| caption    | str                                | ``None`` uses the default; ``""`` removes it.                                                                                                                                                | `None`       |
| figsize    | (float, float)                     |                                                                                                                                                                                              | `None`       |
| ax         | matplotlib Axes                    |                                                                                                                                                                                              | `None`       |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                     | Description   |
|--------|--------------------------|---------------|
|        | matplotlib.figure.Figure |               |
